tools.name: size_loan
tools.description: Size an apartment loan the way a lender does: the lowest of the LTV, DSCR and debt-yield limits.

tools.name: compare_programs
tools.description: Max refinance loan under each agency program's published limits (Fannie Mae Small Loans, Freddie Mac Conventional Small, HUD 223(f)) plus a bank case.

tools.name: cash_out
tools.description: Net cash to the borrower from a cash-out refinance after payoff, prepayment, closing costs and reserves.

tools.name: bridge_takeout
tools.description: Test whether a bridge loan refinances into permanent debt at stabilization; returns surplus or shortfall, NOI needed and the highest workable rate.

tools.name: refinance_break_even
tools.description: Refinance now and pay the prepayment cost, or wait for the open window.

tools.name: maturity_timeline
tools.description: Dated refinance milestones working back from a loan maturity date.

tools.name: check_eligibility
tools.description: Screen a deal against published Fannie Mae Small Loans, Freddie Mac Conventional Small and HUD 223(f) criteria.

tools.name: match_programs
tools.description: Rank loan programs for a deal with the reasons each fits or fails.
